description: Timing and usage of one completion result, turned into the popover footer (aiResultStatsText), its tooltip (aiResultStatsTitle) and the request log's additions (aiTimingLogParts in core, timing_log_parts in Desktop's request_log.rs). footer null: no stats (no timing). Speed is output tokens over (total - first token), or over the total without a first-token time; no usage, or a zero count, estimates outputChars / 4 and marks it with ~.
